To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

WeChat, Telegram and Viber do not store any forensically relevant artifacts on the Android file system and therefore it is difficult to extract any information from them during the forensic investigation.
the forensic analysis of encrypted instant messenger applications on Android is possible but it requires more time and effort as compared to the analysis of non-encrypted applications.
the forensic analysis of the IM applications on Android is possible but it requires a lot of time and expertise.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the collection and analysis of the artifacts from encrypted IM applications on Android smartphones.
the collection, extraction and analysis of forensically significant data from encrypted chat applications on Android devices.
understanding the forensic implications of the encrypted IM applications and their data collection.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the forensic analysis of encrypted IM applications is possible and the artifacts collected from these application can be analyzed to some extent.
the IM applications are storing the user data and other artifacts in a manner that makes it difficult to recover and analyze them during a forensic investigation.
the data collected during the forensic analysis of encrypted IM applications on Android is very less and it is not sufficient for a complete investigation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the artifacts of encrypted IM applications are not stored in the same manner.
we present the artifacts and forensic challenges faced by the investigators during the collection of data from the encrypted IM applications.
the IM applications are not completely immune to the digital forensics.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the forensic analysis of encrypted IM applications can be performed by the investigators and the results of this study can be used to improve the existing digital forensic tools.
the data stored by the IM applications can be collected and analyzed by using the ADB tool.
the forensic investigators should have the knowledge of the IM applications and their data storage mechanisms to perform forensic analysis of the encrypted IM applications on Android.
